lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
He stood beneath the heavy velvet drapes
Watching the shadows dance across the floor
A single candle flickered in the gloom
While silence echoed in the hollow room
[Chorus]
The storm is rising in his chest
A wilder tide that will not rest
The mountains shake, the rivers roar
He finds the truth he was searching for
[Verse]
Each word he spoke was like a stone
A heavy weight he carried all alone
The walls began to lean and groan
Until the seeds of chaos were sown
[Chorus]
The storm is rising in his chest
A wilder tide that will not rest
The mountains shake, the rivers roar
He finds the truth he was searching for
[Bridge]
The ceiling cracked and fell away
The night dissolved into the gray
[Chorus]
The storm is rising in his chest
A wilder tide that will not rest
The mountains shake, the rivers roar
He finds the truth he was searching for
[Outro]
